page.overview:
Who is Blacklegges the Giant?

Blacklegges was a Giant who served as an infamous stevedore of the Rusting Harbour in the pirate city-state of Sartosa. He was killed in the Battle of Sartosa, decapitated by a cannon ball fired from the Bloody Reaver.

Awoken by the sounds of the battle and still drunk on rum, Blacklegges managed to take down many of the Dreadfleet's minions with the remains of a loading crane while on a laughing rampage until the moment of his death.
